meaning: Behavioral models for offline experiments. Every parameter is a modeled condition, not a hardware measurement. Enumerated worlds have no probability weights.

profiles.description: Models the reference lesson that package update errors and postinst UID evidence are independent. This is not a firmware emulator.
Models a separate Fetcher route after a denied HiUtils write; all runtime results here are invented.

Historical pre-marker hypothetical branches, retained as regression cases. A later owner report establishes bounded write/readback/removal on that unit; these synthetic worlds are not new hardware evidence and must not reopen resolved same-unit tests. Execution and root remain unverified.
A diagnostic page failure can be resolved without changing firmware permissions.
An absent HiUtils wrapper leaves a separately available service bridge.
No available modeled bridge; no write experiments follow.
A structured denial is preserved, unlike permission words in returned file content.
A demonstrated argument mismatch changes the argument, not the permission conclusion.
The source contract selects a string-form request without spraying a writing endpoint.
Truncated source produces a precise source-collection dependency.
Both modeled write paths are explicitly denied. This is not a verdict about all real VIDAA routes.
An asynchronous deletion completes after several virtual ticks and needs repeated readback.
A return value arrives but deletion never completes; later privilege tests remain unexecuted.
A custom HTTP status validator accepts 404, so the intended cleanup instead writes a body to the owned virtual marker.
Write success is rejected when readback differs; the owned marker is still cleaned up.
A runtime network prerequisite differs from a permission failure.
A wakeup prerequisite prevents the modeled Fetcher operation.
A package runs, but its runtime proof reports a nonzero UID.
A successful package return without independent runtime proof is not root.
An old-session proof is rejected even when it contains UID zero.
UID evidence must belong to the specific diagnostic package.
A truthy/coerced UID string is not accepted as structured proof.
Root execution and cleanup are tracked separately; leftover metadata is reported.
